editorial:
Two teenage girls obsessed with death run a true-crime blog and decide to become famous by causing real-life tragedies in their quiet Midwestern town. McKayla and Sadie are best friends who will do anything for followers, and their plan quickly spirals out of control. The movie mixes bloody horror with sharp comedy, giving you a fun, twisted ride that never takes itself too seriously. You will laugh at their wild schemes while also feeling a little nervous about what they might do next, making it a unique blend of scares and laughs.

The acting from the two leads is energetic and believable, and the fast pacing keeps you hooked from start to finish. The kills are creative and the jokes land well, though some scenes feel a bit over the top for casual viewers. If you enjoy dark humor and slasher movies, this is a great pick for a weekend night with friends. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, McKayla and Sadie's friendship breaks apart when their egos clash, leading to a deadly showdown between the two. Sadie survives and frames McKayla for the murders, becoming the town's hero and a famous horror icon. The twist reveals that Sadie was the more dangerous one all along, and she walks away free while the world celebrates her as a survivor. You realize the true villain was hiding in plain sight the whole time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedy and slasher horror.
